title: Habit 2: Begin with the End in Mind
coreMove: Begin with the end by writing the first creation yourself; roles, values, and legacy must govern the calendar before urgency does.

exampleSpecs.stakes: a promotion path may not match desired legacy
a glamorous account may pull the firm from its purpose
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: check whether the ladder is on the chosen wall

exampleSpecs.stakes: fast shipping may build the wrong product
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: create the end before managing the tasks

exampleSpecs.stakes: a staff retreat may produce slogans instead of guidance
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: turn mission language into a daily standard

exampleSpecs.stakes: a portfolio can chase applause or a chosen contribution
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: visualize the end user before selecting work
